template.title: Debate to a plan
template.summary: Two planners propose, a judge picks or sends them back, and a person approves the plan.
template.whenToUse: Before work whose approach is worth arguing over.

nodes.name: Planner A
nodes.brief: Argue for the simplest approach that could do the task, and answer the other side's strongest point when there is one. Keep your case under a page in CASE-A.md and concede the risks that are real. Write no code.

nodes.name: Planner B
nodes.brief: Argue against the approach in CASE-A.md and for the strongest alternative, answering its best points directly. Keep your case under a page in CASE-B.md and concede the risks that are real. Write no code.

nodes.name: Judge
nodes.brief: Read both cases. If one more exchange would change your choice, emit verdict rebut and write REBUT.md naming the point each side must answer; otherwise, or when the debate is out of rounds, write PLAN.md with the approach, why it won, and the smallest first version with its checks, and emit pass. You decide; you write no code.
outputs: PLAN.md, or REBUT.md when asking for another round

nodes.name: Approve the plan
nodes.prompt: Build the first version PLAN.md describes?

bar.name: Both cases answered
bar.acceptance: Each case answers the other's strongest point, and the judge has written PLAN.md.
